title.narrative: Strengthening national capacities for gender-transformative education

description.narrative: National capacities will be strengthened to deliver gender-transformative education through better data to inform action on gender equality; legal, policy and planning frameworks to advance rights; and teaching and learning practices to empower learners. Based on the strategy for gender equality in and through education 2026-2029, national and institutional capacities, particularly teacher capacity and capacity to collect data, will be strengthened, global leadership, standard setting and strategic vision on gender equality in and through education provided, including the revision or implementation of normative instruments, contributions to Global Priority Gender Equality made, and high-level policy dialogue on gender equality and for investments in girls’ and women’s education facilitated.
